description: Summary of Deposits (SOD): deposits held at each branch of an FDIC-insured bank as of June 30 of a survey year, in thousands of US dollars, with the branch address, city, state, ZIP, and branch/office identifiers. Pass a cert (and optionally year, state, city); year defaults to the latest survey year published. Returns branches ranked by deposits, plus the sum of the branches returned. Source: FDIC, Summary of Deposits annual branch survey.

cert.description: FDIC certificate number (required unless state and city are both given)

state.description: Two-letter state code of the branch (e.g. "IA")

year.description: Survey year (June 30 snapshot), e.g. 2024. Omit for the latest published year.

name: fdic_branch_deposits

branch_deposits.description: Deposits at the branch, thousands of USD

data_as_of.description: When the FDIC index was built

deposits_in_returned_branches.description: Sum of branch deposits returned, in thousands of USD

deposits_total_is_complete.description: True when the sum covers every matching branch

hint.description: How to fix an empty result

truncated.description: True when more branches matched than returned

title: Fdic Branch Deposits
